scripts.lint: pnpm --filter "./packages/frontend" run lint && pnpm --filter "./packages/backend" run prisma:generate && pnpm --filter "./packages/backend" run lint:ci
scripts.test: pnpm --filter "./packages/design-system" run test && pnpm --filter "./packages/frontend" run test && pnpm --filter "./packages/backend" run test
scripts.build:backend: pnpm --filter "./packages/backend" run prisma:generate && pnpm --filter "./packages/backend" run build
scripts.ci: pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run build:backend
